method: Both actual browser contact PNGs opened with view_image. Each contains five scene rows and four simulation instants; two image reviews are counted.
checks: Ten distinct empty localized architectural/landscape sequences visible across the two contacts.
Native water, cloth, paper, cable, fan, lift and foliage geometry changes across four simulation instants.
No character, vehicle body, weapon attack or new game-state effect appears.
The actual cycles, reduced motion, paused frame equality and all four mode selections pass RGBA assertions.
